items.en: Russia reportedly loses three aircraft and seven aircrew while repelling Ukrainian drone attack on St Petersburg region — friendly fire suspected
items.nl: Rusland verliest naar verluidt drie toestellen en zeven bemanningsleden bij afslaan Oekraïense droneaanval op regio Sint-Petersburg — eigen vuur vermoed
items.sEn: Russia reportedly lost three aircraft and seven aircrew on the night of 11 November 2026 while repelling a large Ukrainian drone attack on St Petersburg and the Leningrad region. items.en: Ukrainian intelligence: Kh-47M2 Kinzhal shares ~90% of its components with the Iskander-M's 9M723, and 58 Russian firms make it
items.nl: Oekraïense inlichtingendienst: Kh-47M2 Kinzjal is voor ~90% opgebouwd uit Iskander-M-onderdelen (9M723), en 58 Russische bedrijven maken hem
items.sEn: On 12 October Ukraine's Defence Intelligence (HUR/DIU) published a breakdown of the Kh-47M2 Kinzhal and its production chain, including an interactive 3D model on its War&Sanctions portal, as reported by Militarnyi and Euromaidan Press. HUR gives the missile the Russian industrial designation 9-S-7760 and describes it…

items.en: Why Does Russia Need More Than 40 MiG-31 Kinzhal Carriers if It Has Only About 100 Missiles?
items.nl: Waarom heeft Rusland meer dan 40 MiG-31 Kinzhal-dragers nodig als het maar zo'n 100 raketten heeft?
items.sEn: According to an analysis by Defense Express (Ivan Kyrychevskiy, July 20, 2026), Russia now operates more than 40 MiG-31K/I aircraft converted to carry the Kh-47M2 Kinzhal hypersonic missile, while the stockpile of that weapon stands at only around 100 units, according to Ukraine's Defense Intelligence directorate (HUR…
